title: Muriel N NDE 7852/7606 NDE 7606
content:
Pour plus d'informations sur le livre de Muriel, cliquez ici. Following a removal of my uterus, the day after the operation, I felt very tired and fuzzy. While I was checking the container that retrieves the result of the drain, I realized that it was filled with blood. I had time to alert the staff. They ran over and I noted that my condition was deemed very worrisome. The first thing I felt was one of well-being that came over me. Then I saw a white, but not blinding light, intensified. The more light appeared, the better I felt. The light eventually enveloped me like a sheet. As it did, I started to perceive a figure standing at the end of my bed, like a mirage. It was a very tall man who was about 2 meters and who stared at me with eyes as blue as the sky, an intense and deep look that penetrates the soul. This man was of great beauty, his face illuminated by perfect features. He sported a short beard, his hair mingled in the white light. I fell in LOVE before this being of light. A Love I had never met before (At I write this, I'm crying. Despite the years, that event always moves me just as much). He wore on his left arm a large open book and a pencil or a pen; I saw this object as 'living.' He intensified his focus on my eyes and asked me a question: 'What do you want?' he asked in a soft, audible voice. 'I want time to kiss my 5 children, the time to tell my family how much I love them.' 'What do you want in your life?' 'I would like to understand my mistakes; why so many trials? I would like to understand nature, science, love.' The man slowly wrote down all my wishes in his books, and said, 'I'll show you your life.' (It still makes me cry ...) I saw my mistakes. I saw trees, nature, oceans, sky, animals as they passed in front of my eyes. I understood, or rather I learned as in a lesson; all my senses were awakened and my entire being reacted. In fact, all was LOVE; even mathematics (which was really not for me!) I felt like I was reintroduced to happiness, LOVE, empathy, etc. I was given a mission with battered women because unfortunately, I was one of those women abused by their husbands. I had no notion of how long both of us spent LOVING one another. It was an unconditional Love without physical contact. It was through all thoughts; in all tenderness, and maybe in all simplicity. The white light dissipated, then I came back to 'the world of the living' with some violence and pain. I was again transferred directly to the operating room where I decided to let go of a body that was painful to me. I felt myself pop out through the top of my head. I hovered over this body that I no longer wanted as I saw the medical team busy itself in silence. The light reappeared, I followed her but saw nothing. I heard again a question, 'What do you want ?' I chose to come back to my body although the temptation to continue on this path of Love was attractive.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related. Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening. Significant hemorrhage | Yes Surgery-related Life threatening event, but not clinical death Following a hysterectomy, I felt strong pain in my belly and I was really tired. I looked at the catheter drain at my right side and saw that the bag was filling with blood too fast. I had time to inform the medical staff. They noticed the state I was in and then everything happened very fast. There was a palpable tension of all the nurses and doctors taking turns at my side. I was getting more and more tired. I heard a nurse saying to one of her colleagues, ‘We will lose her...her blood pressure is down to 4/12...’ I have a rare blood type AB+
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Unearthly light | Strong emotional tone | Special knowledge or purpose | Life review | Awareness of the future | Boundary | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I clearly left my body and existed outside it | Yes I felt myself floating above the big lamp that lights the table. The only person I questioned shortly was the anesthetist. I told her what I saw and felt. I told her of the presence of a tall man at my side. She assured me that no such person was at my side, and concerning the operating room, that what I perceived was correct but that I was supposed being under anesthetic. She asked me if I wanted to talk about it, but I didn't want to. I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal I was much more receptive and attentive. | More consciousness and alertness than normal I was able to distinguish my priorities, at the most. Which included: to listening to this being rather than to fight and panic.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When the being of light appeared | At the moment when this man appeared at the end of my bed.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning The notion of time did NOT exist! | Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning The moments of 'resurrection' were due to the fact that blood bags were given and brought me back shortly, and when I understood that there was nothing to fear of my second state, I just let myself glide into it more easily.
elements.Were your senses more vivid than usual?: Incredibly more vivid | More vivid than usual
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: My sight was only focused on what was happening at the end of my bed, at the end of my feet. | Before this encounter, I felt myself dying slowly. I had great fear. Then came the moment when I let go in safety and Love. Everything got bearable and even beyond that.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: My hearing and my sight reacted only to that Light and the Being standing by my side. Nothing else existed. | I heard the medical staff. It resonated like crystal, no echoes, no interference or noises from the corridor, I would say rather sharp and crystalline sounds.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: No | Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes A light that was very white, but not blinding. The light was as if it were alive. | Yes 'Evanescent' light, it was almost 'alive', white non-blinding, soft, enveloping, physical.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I was flying above regions such as a forest, a savannah, and beings of all nationalities. I was, at the same time, a spectator and a student, I was learning as I flew.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: LOVE and EMPATHY | The strongest emotion was LOVE, calm, assurance of a better future, DESIRE in the sense of the word.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe Everything about the suffering of plants, animals, oceans, but strangely, much less about human beings. | Everything about the universe I felt the suffering of nature, also its life, I understood animals and plants; like a mission that would come.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: No Yes and no. The advice I got was that LOVE would help me, to trust in myself and a great departure was to be foreseen. | I remembered many past events I never doubted it would be like doubting a divine word; I'm sure of what happened without any doubt. But like a treasure I kept it a long time for myself.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from my personal future I knew that my life was going to change. I saw the ocean, sails, freedom, and a mission to help battered women. | Scenes from my personal future I saw myself like a soldier, like a messenger, it would be my duty to inform about the power, which was to help me to overcome my little poor life by any means.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life I was pulled down by the world of the living. | I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will Unpretentious, but I knew that I had to finish my life on earth, in proving to myself that I was strong and committed to promote Love on EARTH!
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life I was pulled down by the world of the living. God, Spiritual and Religion | point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will Unpretentious, but I knew that I had to finish my life on earth, in proving to myself that I was strong and committed to promote Love on EARTH! God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What importance did you place on your re: Not important to me | Slightly important to me
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Unaffiliated- Atheist | Do not know je n'avais aucun avis sur mes choix religieux.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Uncertain I have allowed myself to believe in all religions, since it is LOVE that predominates, in any case. | Uncertain I still didn't adopt a religion. Anyhow my conclusion is the following: In whatever religion, it's LOVE that is the motor of it. So let’s be HAPPY AND LOVE EACH OTHER!
elements.What is your religion now?: No comment depuis, toutes les religions me parlent | Do not know Aujourd'hui, je crois en une forme de force émanant de la Nature. en une protection divine (quelque soi sa provenance). Je suis plus réceptive aux paraboles religieuses d'où qu'elles proviennent ...
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience | Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience I had no religion, partly repressed the messages of beyond. I feared death, suffering, and was not consistent with all my past and unfounded truths, I think that it's in the simplicity of acceptation that I succeeded to find my ways of life.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I made radical decisions about my life, without fear. I have discovered the world of religions and have a great tolerance for each. | Yes I'm much more receptive to religion, whatever kind of religion.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin That being was very tall and resembled Jesus.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: No | Uncertain The being that I could meet, looked, after all, like Jesus.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Uncertain j'existais mais j'appartenais à une masse de personnalité, j'étais MOI et TOUT LE MONDE | Uncertain I covered part of my life as a woman and mother that was before my experience.

No | Uncertain I was always very sensitive with the paranormal without wanting it or working on it. I perceive messages of deceased persons, or people in danger, without being able to control their happening. So this appearance seemed in some way normal to me, but still very intense during the experience.
elements.Did you believe in the existence of God: I was uncertain if God exists
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: No | Yes As I approached this experience, which was in a rather supernatural climate, even religious, with the encounter with the being appearing at the end of the bed.
elements.Do you believe in the existence of God a: God probably exists | God definitely exists
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: experience? God probably exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion | experience? God definitely exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes A message of hope | Yes To open the doors that seem closed and let the light come in through them.
elements.Did you believe that our earthly lives a: Are possibly meaningful and significant | Are probably meaningful and significant
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes | Yes The choice to continue towards the light was indicating interior peace, fullness, and the return towards terrestrial life: pain, but also the chance to come back to it with a knowledge and healthy knowing’s for leaving one or more messages of PEACE around me.
elements.Do you believe in an afterlife after you: An afterlife probably exists Uncertain Since I did not go to the end of that Light, I can't really state that there is LIFE after death. However, I feel an OBLIGATION, when I mention my experience to people, to say (almost with authority) that this happiness can be cultivated while LIVING, without going through such an experience. | An afterlife definitely exists Uncertain Only the fact that we have the choice at this precise moment, or that we are given the choice to come back to EARTH or leave it.
elements.Were you fearful living your life prior: Slightly fearful in living my earthly life | Moderately fearful in living my earthly life
elements.Were you fearful living your life after: Not fearful in living my earthly life
elements.Did you gain information about how to li: No Love without judgment, or any expectation that it will be returned. | Yes Never to feel ALONE. Getting to know that beyond our families, we are accompanied and guided.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: No | Yes See 'meaning or purpose' response above.
elements.Were you compassionate prior to your exp: Moderately compassionate toward others | Greatly compassionate toward others
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes | Yes Of course! But it is there that I also lack the words. It's unconditional LOVE, a look without any judgment. I don't know how to describe this state.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I have become much more compassionate and understanding, and much more patient, and attuned to human beings. Concerning nature, I'm pretty sure that I feel the pain of trees, plants, and animals. | Large changes in my life. I like to go to mass from time to time, reading a book about unbelievable destinies, about matters focusing on psychology. I always loved nature, but now I feel the vibrations of the trees, the suffering of a plant or an animal, I'm sure to get in contact with them
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I avoid superficial people, or if I can't avoid them, I let them know, as diplomatically as possible, that they should ponder the meaning of their lives. My life changed completely. | Yes I feel stronger, I feel protected, what caused to exchange my life, which was full of violence, for a life on a sailboat in the West Indies. My relationships with others are special, as today I have the impression having proved to my children and parents that I loved them, and now I have this urge to travel the world, to explore nature with no accountability towards anybody. I have this strange feeling that I had left there, where I had to go at the time of this experience. But I try to understand my mission on this earth, if there really there is a mission.

elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I cry every time I relate this experience. I think the people in front of me do not understand this emotion 'from elsewhere.' | Yes I cannot find the correct adjectives to describe the man and this evanescent light.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Every time I relate this experience, I again enter a world of Peace and Love. I cry, and as years pass, it does not change in any way; the feelings that remain as sharp as the first time. | I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience At the beginning I didn't talk about, and now I find myself years later, talking quite freely around me except to people being mentally fragile, and as if the experience was yesterday, it's inscribed in me like a tattoo on my soul.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain From the youngest age, I was very sensitive and could feel and see the future of someone close. I often felt I was communicating with dead people in my family. | Yes Premonitory dreams, I always felt being a receiver of messages from deceased people, often messages of love and forgiveness. Today this has intensified.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: LOVE is the most valuable thing. | The appearance of the divine being, the feeling of universal Love, and the courage of one’s own deeds.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes It took me at least two years to tell someone. But each time I do, I still feel as many emotions and I avoid telling too much, because it really shakes me up and people donâ€™t always understand. | Yes I succeeded to talk about it one year after, first to my family, they believed me and listened, as my mother also has a gift of 'clairvoyance', if I can say so. Around myself, I must have been convincing as nobody opposed my saying. But nobody surrounding me had experienced such an experience. In fact I influenced many battered women, or who had been unhappy in their lives. I wrote an autobiography honoring this experience. It will be published this year.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Uncertain Just a little bit because the media did not mention it much. | Yes But I was doubting, with thoughts like, wouldn't it be chemical, the body wouldn't it be going into a chemical phase in order to avoid pain? Or other questions, more mechanical than spiritual.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real What I felt was so deeply anchored into me that there was no doubt about what I had just gone through. | Experience was definitely real For me it is quite real, and the concern with that is that I often feel like being in doubles, the terrestrial part and the one that is no more terrestrial, I rather prefer to name it astral. I'm there without being there. It is a situation that sometimes is embarrassing me in front of others; but that I nevertheless love to take refuge.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I stand by what I said.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: No | Yes I'm giving you the name of my autobiography: 'LE GALET' (The pebble), which will be published with ’Editions du Menhir' and you will notice all the doors that opened for me, to make room for my new life, following that experience.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I don't know if many people lived such an experience, but I have the impression that I had been chosen by this Man of LOVE, in order to make a good being of me. I would so much love to meet people having experienced it, and whose life toppled over in a better dimension. I just tell you: HURRAY FOR LIFE! Let’s not fear death.
